ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetSiteNavigation] ( @ResourceID int = 0 ) AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, NULL AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Monitor' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1 UNION ALL
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, NULL AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Home' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1 UNION ALL
SELECT n.name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( select T.name, AUrl.[Url] as [url], 0 as feature, dbo.ArtifactNgSiteNavigation(T.ObjectID) as items from AssetType T cross apply [dbo].[GetAssetTypeUrlById](T.ID) AUrl left join SiteNav v on v.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and v.Object = 'ArtifactType' WHERE not exists ( select IT.SubjectID from IntersectType IT inner join [Predicate] P on IT.Object = T.Object and IT.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and P.ID = IT.PredicateID and P.Type = 3 ) and v.ObjectID is null and T.Object = 'ArtifactType' and T.[Class] = 1 Order By T.name FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Business' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT n.name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( select T.name, AUrl.[Url] as [url], 0 as feature, dbo.ArtifactNgSiteNavigation(T.ObjectID) as items from AssetType T cross apply [dbo].[GetAssetTypeUrlById](T.ID) AUrl left join SiteNav v on v.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and v.Object = 'ArtifactType' WHERE not exists ( select IT.SubjectID from IntersectType IT inner join [Predicate] P on IT.Object = T.Object and IT.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and P.ID = IT.PredicateID and P.Type = 3 ) and v.ObjectID is null and T.Object = 'ArtifactType' and T.[Class] = 8 Order By T.name FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Technical' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT name, url, 0 as feature, null as items FROM ( SELECT TOP 1000 T.ObjectID, T.Name, dbo.GenerateAssetTypeUrl(T.ID) As url FROM AssetType T left join SiteNav v on v.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and v.Object = 'TaxonomyType' WHERE v.ObjectID is null and T.Object = 'TaxonomyType' ORDER BY T.Name ) BG FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Models' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT name, url, 0 as feature, null as items FROM ( SELECT TOP 1000 T.ObjectID, T.name, dbo.GenerateAssetTypeUrl(T.ID) As url FROM AssetType T left join SiteNav v on v.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and v.Object = 'PolicyType' WHERE v.ObjectID is null and T.Object = 'PolicyType' ORDER BY T.name ) BG FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Policy' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, null AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Reference' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 2 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT FT.name, dbo.GenerateAssetTypeUrl(T.ID) As url, 2 as feature, ( SELECT name, dbo.GenerateAssetUrl(A.ID) As url, 'F' + cast(F.ID as varchar(15)) as menuID, 2 as feature FROM Fusion F inner join Asset A on A.Object = 'Fusion' and A.ObjectID = F.ID WHERE F.FusionTypeID = FT.ID ORDER BY name FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS items FROM FusionType FT inner join AssetType T on T.Object = 'FusionType' and T.ObjectID = FT.ID ORDER BY name FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Fusion' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 4 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT 'People' AS name, 'community/groups' AS url, 0 as feature, NULL AS Items FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Community' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1 UNION ALL SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT RT.name, dbo.GenerateAssetTypeUrl(T.ID) As url, 0 as feature, null AS items FROM RuleType RT inner join AssetType T on T.Object = 'RuleType' and T.ObjectID = RT.ID LEFT JOIN SiteNav v on v.ObjectID = RT.ID and v.Object ='RuleType' WHERE v.ObjectID IS NULL Order By RT.name FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Data Quality' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT DISTINCT R.name, CONCAT('dashboard/',R.ID) As url, 0 as feature, null AS items FROM Report R left join ReportResponsibility rs on rs.ReportID = R.ID left join ResponsibilityDetail rd on rd.ResponsibilityTypeID = rs.ResponsibilityTypeID and @ResourceID = rd.ResourceID WHERE (rs.ResponsibilityTypeID is not null and rd.ResourceID = @ResourceID) or (rd.ResourceID is null and rs.ResponsibilityTypeID is null) Order By R.name FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Dashboards' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT '~' + Name AS MenuID, s.SortOrder, 0 AS Feature, s.Icon as Icon, s.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, s.Title as Title, dbo.CustomSiteNavigation(ID) AS Items from SiteNav s where ParentID IS NULL and Name not like '#%' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(s.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
order by sortorder END

alter proc [dbo].[GetPageInformation] @o varchar(50), @oid int, @rid int as begin declare @breadcrumbsRaw table ([Level] int, [TypeName] nvarchar(500), [Name] nvarchar(max), [TypeUrl] nvarchar(2500), [Url] nvarchar(2500)); declare @breadcrumbs table ([Name] nvarchar(max), [Url] nvarchar(2500), Active bit, IsType bit);
with h as ( select A.ID, A.[ObjectID], A.AssetTypeID, I.SubjectID as [ParentID], 0 as [Level] from Asset A left join PredicateIntersect I on I.Object = A.Object and I.ObjectID = A.ObjectID and I.PredicateType = 3 where A.[Object] = @o and A.ObjectID = @oid union all select P.ID, P.[ObjectID] as ID, P.AssetTypeID, I.SubjectID as ParentID, h.[Level]-1 as [Level] from Asset P inner join h on P.[Object] = @o and P.ObjectID = h.ParentID outer apply ( select SubjectID from PredicateIntersect where Object = P.Object and ObjectID = P.ObjectID and PredicateType = 3 ) I )
insert into @breadcrumbsRaw select distinct [Level], ltrim(rtrim(T.Name)), ltrim(rtrim(D.DisplayValue)), UT.Url, U.Url from h inner join AssetType T on T.ID = h.AssetTypeID left join AssetDisplayValue D on D.AssetID = h.ID cross apply dbo.GetAssetUrlByID(h.ID) U cross apply dbo.GetAssetTypeUrlById(T.ID) UT where ltrim(rtrim(T.Name)) is not null and ltrim(rtrim(D.DisplayValue)) is not null order by [Level]
select distinct O.[Uid], O.ObjectID as ID, O.ID as AssetID, O.AssetTypeID, OD.DisplayValue, T.Name as [TypeName], T.Class, case when Dash.[Count] > 0 then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as HasDashboards, case when Work.[Count] > 0 then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as HasWorkflow, case when Child.[Count] > 0 then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as HasChildArtifacts, case when Attr.[Count] > 0 then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as AllowAttributes, case when Hier.[Count] > 0 then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as AllowPredicateHierarchies, ( select * from ( select P.ID as [ID], P.Name as [Name] from [Predicate] P where exists(SELECT * FROM IntersectType IT WHERE P.[type] = 6 and P.ID = IT.PredicateID and ((IT.Subject = T.Object and IT.SubjectID = T.ObjectID) OR (IT.Object = T.Object and IT.ObjectID =T.ObjectID))) union select P.ID as [ID], P.Name as [Name] from [NymRelation] R inner join [dbo].[predicate] P on P.ID = R.PredicateID where R.[Object] = T.Object and R.ObjectID = T.ObjectID ) NMT for json path ) as NymTypes, ( select * from @breadcrumbsRaw for json path ) as Breadcrumbs from Asset O inner join AssetType T on T.ID = O.AssetTypeID left join dbo.GetAssetDisplayValue() OD on OD.ID = O.ID
cross apply ( select count(1) as [Count] from Report where ObjectType = O.Object and ObjectID = T.ObjectID ) Dash cross apply ( select count(1) as [Count] from workflow.EventRegistration WER inner join workflow.Type WT on WER.TypeID = WT.ID and WT.PublishedVersionID is not null and WT.[State] = 1 and WER.ChangeType = 8 where WER.Object = T.Object and WER.ObjectID = T.ObjectID ) Work cross apply ( select count(1) as [Count] from [PredicateIntersect] where Subject = O.Object and SubjectID = O.ObjectID and PredicateType = 3 ) Child cross apply ( select count(1) as [Count] from AttributeTypeRelation where ObjectType = T.Object and ObjectID = T.ObjectID ) Attr cross apply ( select count(1) as [Count] from IntersectType IT inner join [Predicate] P on P.ID = IT.PredicateID and P.[Type] = 3 where ((IT.Subject = T.Object and IT.SubjectID = T.ObjectID) OR (IT.Object = T.Object and IT.ObjectID = T.ObjectID)) ) Hier where O.Object = @o and O.ObjectID = @oid and not exists (select 1 from ResponsibilityDetail where PermissionsBitMask & 1 = 0 and ResourceID = @rid and ( (AssetID = O.ID) OR (AssetTypeID = O.AssetTypeID and AssetID = 0))) for json path, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER end

ALTER FUNCTION [utility].[ObjectDetail] ( @type varchar(50), @id int ) RETURNS @tbl TABLE ( ID int, AssetID bigint, UID uniqueidentifier, AssetTypeID int, AssetTypeUid uniqueidentifier, Name nvarchar(max), TextPath nvarchar(2500), Description nvarchar(max), ParentID int null, ParentType nvarchar(250), Url nvarchar(2500), TypeID int, [Type] varchar(25), [TypeName] nvarchar(250), [Class] int, IconBackColor varchar(15), IconForeColor varchar(15), IconText varchar(15), Status nvarchar(25) null ) AS BEGIN if @type in ( 'Artifact', 'Attribute', 'Fusion', 'FusionAttribute', 'Policy', 'ReferenceItem', 'Rule', 'Taxonomy', 'Group', 'FusionQueryAttribute', 'Resource' ) begin insert into @tbl ( ID, UID, AssetID, AssetTypeID, AssetTypeUid, Name, TextPath, [Description], ParentID, ParentType, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class], Status) SELECT ObjectID, UID, ID, AssetTypeID, AssetTypeUid, DisplayValue, DisplayValue, NULL, null, null, dbo.GenerateAssetUrl(ID), TypeID, Type, TypeName, AssetTypeClass, NULL FROM AssetDetail where Object = @type and ObjectID = @id end
if @type in ( 'ArtifactType', 'AttributeType', 'FusionType', 'FusionAttributeType', 'FusionQueryAttributeType', 'PolicyType', 'ReferenceItemType', 'RuleType', 'TaxonomyType' ) begin insert into @tbl ( ID, AssetTypeUid, [Uid], Name, TextPath, [Description], ParentID, ParentType, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class]) SELECT ObjectID, O.[Uid], O.[Uid], Name, Name, Description, NULL, NULL, turl.[url] as Url, ObjectID, @type, 'Asset Type', O.[Class] FROM AssetType O cross apply [dbo].GetAssetTypeUrlById(o.id) turl WHERE Object = @type and ObjectID = @id end
if @type = 'Intersect' begin insert into @tbl ( ID, Name, TextPath, [Description], ParentID, ParentType, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class]) SELECT O.ID, IName.Name, IName.Name, '', NULL, @type, null, O.IntersectTypeID, 'IntersectType', ITN.Name, 0 FROM [Intersect] O INNER JOIN IntersectType T ON O.IntersectTypeID = T.ID and O.ID = @id CROSS APPLY dbo.GetIntersectNames(O.ID) IName CROSS APPLY dbo.GetIntersectTypeNames(T.ID) ITN end
if @type = 'IntersectType' begin insert into @tbl ( ID, Name, TextPath, [Description], ParentID, ParentType, Url, TypeID, [Type], TypeName, [Class],[UID]) SELECT ID, T.Name, T.Name, '', NULL, NULL, null, ID, @type, 'Intersect Type', 0, uid FROM IntersectType CROSS APPLY dbo.GetIntersectTypeNames(@id) T WHERE ID = @id end
